description: This Java class 'AccountService' provides methods to retrieve bank and utility account data, interacting with repositories and using mappers to convert between entities and DTOs.

classes.name: AccountService
classes.description: A service component for managing account retrieval operations in the financial application.

methods.name: readBankAccount
methods.description: Retrieves a BankAccount DTO by account number, throwing exception if not found.

methods.name: readUtilityAccount (by provider)
methods.description: Retrieves a UtilityAccount DTO by provider name, throwing exception if not found.

methods.name: readUtilityAccount (by ID)
methods.description: Retrieves a UtilityAccount DTO by account ID, throwing exception if not found.
